prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent painterly foliage fringe sprite atlas for a low-poly isometric game.
Create a 1536 by 1024 image with EXACTLY SIX equally sized panels arranged in 3 columns, 2 rows, NO labels, NO borders, NO grid lines. Background fully transparent. Each panel contains ONE broad, asymmetrical dense branch cluster isolated on transparency, filling about 90% of its panel but not touching any panel edge. Its small leaves overlap densely at the center and taper into irregular individual leaf silhouettes at its outside edges. No ground, no horizon, no trunk, no pot, no scenery. These are flat diffuse painted albedo sprites that will soften the edge of a 3D thicket, not illustrations of separate full plants. No shadows on the background. Muted olive, khaki, umber, earthy sage painterly game art; opaque leaves, fine warm light edging, rich softly painted shadow within the cluster.
TOP LEFT: tangled temperate bramble branch spray with small dusty olive oaklike leaves, a few ochre leaves, and thin interweaving woody stems. Broad irregular asymmetrical oval, not a starburst.
TOP MIDDLE: jungle leafy branch with medium elongated olive-green broad leaves and two looping thin vines. Broad diagonal spray, not a rosette or whole tree.
TOP RIGHT: dense evergreen bough spray, warm white snow cushions laid atop muted blue-green needles and brown small branch tips. Broad horizontal bough, snowy upper lobes and needle fringe at bottom, not white rocks.
BOTTOM LEFT: dry thorn scrub branch with narrow ochre and sage leaves, sparse tan grass seed heads, many fine branching brown twigs. Broad tangled irregular shape.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: a dense irregular group of slender upright khaki reeds and drooping sage willow leaves. Leaves arc gently sideways and down, a few slender tan reed heads reach above, rootlike stems below. Broad cluster, NOT a fern rosette, NOT a palm, NOT a single round bush.
BOTTOM RIGHT: interwoven waterlogged brown roots and slender dead branches with a little moss, broad diagonal weave, isolated.
All sprites have detailed natural irregular silhouette edges and transparent spaces only between their outermost leaves. Dense opaque leafy centers. Consistent painterly style and diffuse light across all six. No text. Genuine alpha transparency.
